pages.text: Press $(k:key.jobsplus.open_menu) to open the Jobs menu and join two jobs. A job levels up from its own work and pays one $(item)job coin$() per level.$(br2)Spend coins in the same menu on power-ups. Two jobs is the most anyone can hold. To swap one, type $(thing)/leavejob <job>$(): it deletes that job's level and power-ups for good.

The nine jobs: Alchemist, Cook, Enchanter, Explorer, Farmer, Hunter, Jeweler, Miner and Smith.$(br2)Seven of them also $(l)make$() things nobody else can: Smith, Hunter, Enchanter, Jeweler, Alchemist, Cook and Explorer.
